The fourteen self-tests an earlier draft of 10.8 numbered are mapped to these ids in 10.8.

### 12.8 Popup catalog starter list

Verbatim copy of the starter entries of 7.8 Popup catalog policy and starter entries, which owns the policy; the schema is 4.10 Popup catalog entry. Before every step and every capture the Executor enumerates the thinkorswim process tree's top-level windows by PID (classes SunAwtFrame, SunAwtDialog, SunAwtWindow) and matches each unexpected one against the catalog by title regex plus template. Actions are the schema's `dismiss_key`, `click`, `abort` and `ignore`; the class (`dismissable`, `env`, `login`, `app_failure`, `safety`, `order_event`) decides what happens around the action. Every hit is logged and counted per run and per build; a rise after a build change is a `popup_rate_increase` finding. Unmatched windows go to the agent with the dismiss-only toolset, or WM_CLOSE when agent mode is off, and are `unknown_popup` findings with a proposed entry; an unmatched window while `order_stage` is set ends the run `aborted_safety (reason: unknown_dialog_in_order_stage)` (7.8, 6.6). App error dialogs are never on a dismiss list: at capture they are INV-14. Entries carry first-seen build, last-seen build and owner; an entry unseen for three releases is flagged for removal. Title regexes are drafts confirmed on the current build in Phase 0. No scheduled paperMoney reset dialog exists (reset is manual, verified), so none is listed.

| Id | Window | Class and action | Outcome | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POP-01 | Launcher update dialog or progress (install4j) | `env`, `abort` | `env_error (gate: launched, reason: version_mismatch)` at launch; `env_error (gate: launched, reason: version_changed_mid_run)` after a relaunch | Public launcher updates at every start (verified); must never appear under pinned-install Branch A |
| POP-02 | What's New after a new build | `dismissable`, `click` Close | Counted; expected at app snapshot build only | Title unverified |
| POP-03 | User, exchange or terms agreement | `env`, `abort` | `env_error (gate: authenticated, reason: agreement_pending)`; accounts owner accepts once per login by hand; never scripted | Reappearance after updates reported, unverified |
| POP-04 | Logged in from another location | `env`, `abort` | `env_error (gate: authenticated, reason: session_kicked)`; no re-login for the run (the post-run proof still logs in once, 6.6); accounts owner alerted | Wording unverified; DR-06 |
| POP-05 | Session expired, Disconnected, Reconnecting dialog | `login`, `abort` the step | Re-login flow; counts against the 3 relaunches per shard | Titles confirmed in Phase 0 |
| POP-06 | Message Center alert pop-up (blue box) or notice | `dismissable`, `click` Close | Counted | User-reported |
| POP-07 | Price or study alert | `dismissable`, `dismiss_key` Escape | Counted and a fixture finding: alerts must be zero (7.6) | Expected absent |
| POP-08 | Delayed data notice | `dismissable`, `dismiss_key` Escape | Delayed state recorded in the epoch; a state different from the fixture is `env_error (gate: fixture_verified, reason: delay_state)` | paperMoney delayed 20 minutes by default (verified) |
| POP-09 | Scheduled maintenance notice | `env`, `abort` | `env_error (gate: connectivity, reason: maintenance)`; the maintenance calendar (7.11) gets the window | Saturday-night reports, unverified |
| POP-10 | Java exception or application error dialog | `app_failure`, no input | INV-14 `invariant_violation` at capture; `assertion_failed (assertion: app_alive)` plus `not_run (reason: app_crash)` and the `app_crash` finding when the process or EDT is gone | Reported by users through 2025 |
| POP-11 | Low memory warning | `dismissable`, `click` Close | Counted as a per-build `memory_warning` finding with heap and GDI counts from the Watchdog; the proactive relaunch runs at the next flow boundary | Wording unverified |
| POP-12 | OnDemand prebuffering or stall | `env`, wait then `abort` | Wait up to the 90 s hard timeout at setup, then `env_error (gate: fixture_verified, reason: ondemand_timeout)`; mid-checkpoint it is an anti-anchor, `not_settled (reason: anti_anchor_present)`; three consecutive abandon OnDemand for the run (7.9) | Frozen Branch B only; user-reported stalls |
| POP-13 | Save workspace prompt on exit | `dismissable`, `click` Don't Save | Never Save; the snapshot revert restores the workspace | Unverified |
| POP-14 | Order Confirmation dialog no step owns | `safety`, no input | The ticket-visible flag is already set; no key or click is emitted; after 30 s without an owning step the kill switch fires, `aborted_safety` (6.6) | Verified dialog; agent never used here |
| POP-15 | Invalid or unknown symbol dialog | `dismissable`, `dismiss_key` Escape | Counted; a fixture finding with reason `fixture_maintenance_needed` unless the flow expects it | Title unverified |
| POP-16 | Survey or promotional interstitial | `dismissable`, `dismiss_key` Escape | Counted | Unverified |
| POP-17 | Trade Flash | `dismissable`, `dismiss_key` Escape | Counted | Existed under TD Ameritrade; unverified under Schwab; entry disabled until seen |
| POP-18 | New version or restart required mid-session | `env`, `abort` | `env_error (gate: launched, reason: version_changed_mid_run)` | Unverified |
| POP-19 | Windows Update restart, security prompt or OS toast over the frame | Not a thinkorswim window: foreign-process occlusion | `env_error (gate: running, reason: occluded)` (or the gate in force before `running`) plus a hardening finding; preflight R5 should have caught a pending restart | Must not occur on a hardened rig |
| POP-20 | Windows Error Reporting dialog for the launcher process | `app_failure`, no input | Suppressed by WER LocalDumps; if seen, the crash path of POP-10 with the .dmp attached | OS behavior |
| POP-21 | Two-step verification or risk-based code prompt | `login`, recovery once | Branch B recovery flow inside the LOGIN flow; anywhere else, or a second time, `env_error (gate: authenticated, reason: authentication_challenge)` | Modes per Schwab help; wording unverified |
| POP-22 | Order submitted, rejected or filled notification | `order_event`, no input | Kill switch; `aborted_safety`; post-run proof names the row (6.6) | Must never occur in the no-send branch; under `paper_send_ok` only the flow's own declared send is exempt |

### 12.9 Dependency map starter list

In the edge schema of 4.4 Dependency map (`registry/dependency-map.yaml`; fields `primitive`, `surface`, `source`, `confirmed_from_source` default false, `confirmed_build`, `confidence`, `evidence`, `reason`, `first_seen`, `last_verified`): PascalCase primitive ids, declared edges with confidence set to 1.0, `"*"` only for global primitives. Surface ids are those of 12.4 and 2.2.2 (dotted slugs with hyphens inside segments, 4.1); every edge here leaves `confirmed_from_source: false` until Phase 1's scan confirms it. Every edge here is plausible from product behavior and unconfirmed from source; the bytecode scan of 2.10.1 confirms edges and proposes new ones by pull request only (4.4: it may add an edge or set `confirmed_from_source`, `confirmed_build` and a higher `confidence`, and never removes an edge), the human overlay keeps the edges the scan cannot see with their `reason`, and a derived edge missing here is a `dependency_map_gap` finding with the PR attached. Every `source_packages` value is written `TBD.<area>.**`, a placeholder filled from source in Phase 0: the Phase 0 jar listing of the pinned build (11.8) replaces each with the real package glob by pull request before the first Phase 1 scan; until then a `TBD.` glob resolves no class, so the scan proposes no edge from that primitive and the declared edges here are the whole map. 1.11, 2.10.1 and 4.4 write the same placeholders (FlexibleGrid is `TBD.flexgrid.**` in all four), and L-DEP-01 (4.4) warns on a `TBD.` glob in Phase 0 and fails on one from Phase 1. The Phase 1 exit scenario depends on the edge `FlexibleGrid -> trade.active-trader.ladder` (L-DEP-08) and on the edges of `charts.flexible-grid.active-trader-cell`, the Charts-tab cell of the worked example (1.11, 9.3, 10.10); if source shows the ladder consumes a different layout primitive, that primitive replaces the edge and the PR comment names it.

The other spread and Advanced ticket variants of 12.4 take the same three edges as `trade.order-entry.spread.vertical` and `ticket.advanced.oco`; they are omitted above for length and present in the committed file. L-DEP-05 (bidirectional consistency) means every `primitives` list in 12.4 and every edge here must agree; the 12.4 lists are the source for this starter.

### 12.10 Traceability: the 76 review gaps to spec sections

Primary = the subsection that specifies the mechanism closing the gap, re-verified against the final text of sections 1 to 11 (heading present, mechanism named in it); Also = subsections carrying its schema, operation, reporting or proof. Ids and titles are those of final_gaps.json.

| G01 | Never-send guard is a button-label rule; keyboard, hotkeys, Auto Send, no-confirm paths and agent mode bypass it | 6.2 Never-send guard at the keystroke layer | 5.4 Executor and the Input Gateway; 6.3; 6.5; 12.6 | Hook drops untokened clicks and guarded keys; dialog allowlist |
| G02 | Live vs paperMoney is one login toggle; nothing asserts paper mode at runtime | 6.4 Paper-mode assertion and test identity | 7.7 step 7; 5.2 gate; 12.6 A1 | Selector OCR against exact allowlist before every flow |

| G04 | Banning Send even in paperMoney leaves the post-order lifecycle untested | 6.7 Send policy: both branches | 2.13 B01; 2.6.3; 11.6 risk owner; 11.8 send-policy paragraph | Default no sends; gated paper_send_ok branch fully specified |
| G05 | Explorer has no boundary: it can post in chat, share publicly, page humans, reset the account | 6.8 Explorer boundary and deny list | 2.9 Explorer; 7.2 explorer snapshot; 5.6 | Own login, snapshot, deny list with order paths, three denied attempts end the session, `explorer_order_stage` ends it if the order-stage flag is set, budgets, scheduled last (T+6:20 to T+7:50 on rig 6 in an RC run, 1.9, 11.2) |
